primary_metric: paired evaluation log loss, equal weight per company-day; date-block uncertainty
publication_age_basis: UTC midnight of source date; uncertain proxy, not verified publication time
selection_rule: first 12 tickers sorted by SHA256('CMIN-student-panel-v1:' + ticker), before outcomes
shared_preprocessing: original delay2 training-only scalers; original feature indices preserved
stop_rule: no broad tuning or automatic dataset changes; retain negative/inconclusive evidence
study_scope: baseline readiness for later interaction, decay and fusion tests; conditional daily prediction, no causal or trading claim
